items.title: Paul Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: Like on alto sax I mean it’s hard to beat Paul Desmond with Brubeck. He got a lovely sound on the instrument.

ctx.x: Music from fellows like John Coltrane that are seemingly very serious and filled with let’s say messages, did that ever appeal to you? © Fillius Jazz Archive -19-

No. I like melodic, good sounds. I like a guy that gets a good sound on his instrument. Like on alto sax I mean it’s hard to beat Paul Desmond with Brubeck. He got a lovely sound on the instrument. You could listen to him, he didn’t get that raucous sound. A lot of guys get a very raucous sound on their instrument, which is exciting if you’re playing raucous jazz, but the guys that I’ve always liked have gotten good sound. Like Lester Young always had a pretty sound on the instrument. Stan Getz always got a…
Let me just follow up on something you said. Some water?
